name: diagnostic-logging
description: DIAGNOSTIC BUILD - activates the ~6700 log call sites that are compiled out. Every one of them calls `dummyLogMsg` instead of `Log_msg`; `dummyLogMsg` is literally `li r3,0 ; blr`, so replacing that one instruction with a branch to the real `Log_msg` makes them all live. ON ITS OWN THIS EMITS NOTHING: `Log_msg` starts by ANDing a global trace mask against the caller's level and returning if the result is zero, and that mask is BSS - zero at boot. Pair it with `diagnostic-logmask`, which forces the mask, or flash that one alone: it already turns on the ~5900 sites that call `Log_msg` directly, including the one that answers whether the AUX handler runs. Both together is a flood. Expect a lot of output and do not drive on it. NAV only for now - the other builds need their own addresses checked before they are listed here.

patches.why: dummyLogMsg (li r3,0 ; blr) -> b Log_msg @ 0x02742558. Log_msg takes r3=level, r4=format and the caller has already set those, so the branch passes them straight through and every gated log site in the image becomes live.
